# Install `cta` — Call to Action

> Brutalist call-to-action section — eyebrow label, serif headline, body, arrow CTA.

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt
📦 Slice detail   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/slices/cta
🧠 JSON catalog   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/api/knowledge?slice=cta
🤖 Prompt page    : https://resource.rahmanef.com/agents/cta

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add cta
# alias: npx rr add cta
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `ui`, `marketing`, `cta`, `section`, `brutalist`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add cta`. <CtaView eyebrow title body href ctaLabel /> renders the full section; <CtaButton href label /> drops a standalone arrow button anywhere. Override tracking-brutal utilities in tailwind.config or swap for tracking-wide if your design system has no brutal preset.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
